decisions.reason: The DPA management software builds directly on the firm's compliance know-how for agencies, and it has positive feedback on its agency templates and its own page, so the firm can interpret and improve it well.
The hosting management platform is the core of the firm's agency-focused strategy, is featured on the home page, and draws on its in-house R&D and integrated tooling.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits very close to the established infrastructure and service know-how and keeps its own page, so the firm can absorb market signals and refine it at low cost.

Extended PHP security support uses the firm's containerized architecture and security expertise, but it is only mentioned on the site and depends on legacy PHP version lifecycles, so it may later be folded into other offers or sunset.
